verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes an official MCP server (github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp). Agents can query sync status read-only by default, and setting FIVETRAN_SCOPE unlocks write and delete operations such as copying connections, with a credential denylist available as a safeguard. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, coverage of it in the main docs site beyond the README (e.g., client setup guides).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp
It allows you to ask read-only questions like "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?"
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
Copy existing Fivetran connections to a new destination. Keep their configs and schemas intact or modify them as you like.
